llm_request: Please review this text for grammar, clarity, and professional wording: "Talked to Chandler today and shared what changes are and he is OK with those. - Moving suggested dual-head cameras from landlord space into our space. - Added single head cameras for each staff entrance. - Added card reader and camera for Med storage area. - Added three motion detectors for print/copy room, Meeting room and server room, just to cover possibility someone coming trough adjacent wall. Please see attached drawings and let me know if anything else to add before sending it t project team."
llm_response:
Here are a few ways to revise your text, depending on how formal you want to be. 

**Option 1: Professional and polished (Recommended)**
*This option is perfect for a standard email to a manager, client, or broader team.*

"I spoke with Chandler today to review the proposed changes, and he is on board with them. The updates include:
*   Relocating the suggested dual-head cameras from the landlord's space into our space.
*   Adding single-head cameras for each staff entrance.
*   Installing an additional card reader and camera for the medical storage area.
*   Installing three motion detectors in the print/copy room, meeting room, and server room to mitigate the risk of someone entering through an adjacent wall.

Please review the attached drawings and let me know if you would like to add anything else before I send this to the project team."

**Option 2: Concise and direct (Great for quick updates or internal messaging)**
*This option tightens the wording to get straight to the point while remaining professional.*

"I discussed the changes with Chandler today, and he approved them. 
*   Moving the suggested dual-head cameras from the landlord's space to ours.
*   Adding single-head cameras to all staff entrances.
*   Adding a card reader and camera to the medical storage area.
*   Adding three motion detectors to the print/copy, meeting, and server rooms for security against the adjacent walls.

Please see the attached drawings and let me know if there are any additions before I forward this to the project team."

**Key corrections made to your original text:**
*   **"Talked to Chandler..."** -> Changed to "I spoke/discussed..." for a more professional opening.
*   **"shared what changes are"** -> Changed to "reviewed the proposed changes" for better grammatical flow.
*   **Consistency:** Made sure all bullet points started with the same verb forms (Moving, Adding/Relocating, Installing).
*   **"through"** -> Corrected the spelling of "trough."
*   **"just to cover possibility someone coming..."** -> Reworded to "mitigate the risk of someone entering" to sound more professional and security-focused.
*   **"t project team"** -> Corrected the typo by adding the missing "o".
